title: A proper direct image detects a comparison off a finite boundary
statement:
Let $b:Y\to S$ be proper, let $a:G\hookrightarrow Y$ be open
with closed complement $i:Z\hookrightarrow Y$, and suppose $bi$
is finite.
Let $c:K\to L$ be a morphism of ordinary
bounded-below derived
etale module complexes.
If $a^*c$ and the
direct image $Rb_*c$ are
isomorphisms, then $c$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Embed c through the fully faithful inclusion D⁺→D. Exact inverse image commutes with this inclusion. The proved compatibility of right derived functors identifies the included bounded-below Rb_*c with the unbounded Rb_* of the included c. Thus both image morphisms remain invertible. The existing exact module pullback needs no passage through abelian sheaves.

source.place: Proof: cone, closed-support recovery, derived composition, finite cohomology detection

proof.text: Complete the included c to a distinguished cone triangle with third term M. Map the triangle by D(a^*) and Rb_*. These functors are triangulated; in both image triangles the first map is invertible, so their third objects vanish, by the triangle criterion isZero₃_iff_isIso₁. Hence D(a^*)M=0 and Rb_*M=0.

source.place: Proof: cone, closed-support recovery, derived composition, finite cohomology detection

proof.text: Apply the existing arbitrary-module open-closed triangle to M. Its first term a_!a^*M is zero, so its second map, the closed adjunction unit M→Ri_*i^*M, is invertible by isZero₁_iff_isIso₂. Write N=D(i^*)M and e:M≅Ri_*N.

source.place: Proof: cone, closed-support recovery, derived composition, finite cohomology detection

proof.text: The direct image i_* is a right adjoint of the exact i^*, hence preserves K-injectives. Apply the proved generic derived composition isomorphism to i_*, b_* and the ordinary lowerStarComp isomorphism. Applying Rb_* to e gives 0≅Rb_*Ri_*N≅R(bi)_*N.

source.place: Proof: cone, closed-support recovery, derived composition, finite cohomology detection

proof.text: Since bi is finite, its direct image is exact and its right derived functor is its termwise derived functor. For every n the exact-functor cohomology comparison gives H^n(R(bi)_*N)≅(bi)_*H^n(N). The left side vanishes. Finite direct image detects zero module sheaves, so every H^n(N) vanishes. DerivedCategory.isZero_iff implies N=0.

source.place: Proof: cone, closed-support recovery, derived composition, finite cohomology detection

proof.text: An additive derived direct image preserves zero objects, hence N=0 and e give M=0. The cone triangle criterion makes the included c invertible. The fully faithful inclusion D⁺→D reflects isomorphisms, yielding IsIso c. The original properness hypothesis is kept unchanged.
